title: Relatively Smart II: Tractable or Semi-Supervised Instance-Optimal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.10886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We continue the study of relatively smart learning, introduced by Dughmi and Pour (2026), which asks a supervised learner to compete, marginal by marginal, with every distribution-fixed error guarantee soundly certifiable from unlabeled data. They showed that the One-Inclusion Graph (OIG) learner is relatively smart with a quadratic sample-complexity blowup, and that no relatively smart learner can do better, leaving open whether ERM or another natural or tractable learner achieves comparable guarantees. They also left open whether the blowup can be restricted to unlabeled data.   Our firs results shows that ERM---and in fact any proper consistent learner---is relatively smart for binary classification in the distribution-free setting. We show that a small certifiable error with $m$ samples implies a similarly small error on the uniform distribution over a random sample of size $O(m^2)$, yielding a cover of size at most $2^{m+1}$ on that

translated_title: 相对智能学习 II：可处理或半监督的实例最优学习
translated_abstract: 我们继续研究由 Dughmi 和 Pour（2026）提出的“相对智能学习”概念，它要求监督学习器在逐一边际的意义上，与每一个能够从无标注数据中可靠验证的、针对固定分布的误差保证相竞争。他们证明了单包含图学习器是相对智能的，但样本复杂度存在二次方膨胀，且任何相对智能学习器都无法做得更好，由此留下了 ERM 或其他自然、可处理的学习器能否达到可比保证的开放问题。他们还留下另一个开放问题：这种样本复杂度膨胀是否可以仅限于无标注数据。我们的第一个结果表明，ERM——实际上是任何正规一致学习器——在无分布设定下的二分类问题中都是相对智能的。我们证明了，若在 m 个样本下具有较小的可验证误差，则意味着在大小为 O(m²) 的随机样本上的均匀分布中也具有类似的较小误差，从而在该样本上产生大小至多为 2^(m+1) 的覆盖……
tldr: 本文证明ERM乃至任何正规一致学习器在无分布二分类中都是相对智能的，从而解决了此前留下的开放问题，即自然的可处理学习器能否达到与单包含图学习器可比的保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that ERM—and in fact any proper consistent learner—is relatively smart for binary classification in the distribution-free setting, resolving the open question of whether natural tractable learners can match the guarantees of the One-Inclusion Graph learner.
